Several people, including the City of Fairhope, have filed complaints with YouTube to have this video removed.  It has been reposted here:  https://vimeo.com/1109614684?share=copy

Please share this video with Fairhope voters!  The incumbents do not want it to be seen!

The original site (VoteFairhope.org) has been redirected to the reposted video, but anyone who has previously visited the link will likely find a dead end (due to cookies/browsing history).  You can also visit www.VoteFairhope.com to see the video.

If you would just remove the seal (and the look alikes) from the thumbnails, there would not be any valid copyright claims.  I looked it up and there is a copyright on it.  Only documents, videos, or any other material from the City can use the seal.  Or is your intention to make them look like they are coming from the city of fairhope?  It pretty much says it there in the complaint..just the thumbnail.  My 2 cents...

You make a good point.  Although the look-alike image is very different from the official seal (different fonts, different words, different colors, different sized circles, different graphics), we do not want to cause confusion.  We believe the City of Fairhope overstepped and violated our fair use and our free speech by shutting down a video that is critical of the council incumbents, particularly when any reasonable person can see that our video is not an official message from the City of Fairhope.  But you are correct, if we remove the look-alike image and repost the video on YouTube, it will be interesting to see if the city tries to have it removed again.

Your “Definitely Not The Seal Of Fairhope” is perfect!  Thank you for sharing our video.  We also have reposted it (AGAIN) at www.FairhopeFirst.org.  So hopefully if we all keep posting and sharing, voters will be informed before they go to the polls on August 26.
